question: What was India’s rank In Paralympic 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**24**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****Tokyo Paralympics 2020:**

__
 
• India finishes 24th with record 19 medals.
 
• India finished their campaign at the Tokyo Paralympics 2020 with an all-time high of 19 medals which includes five gold, eight silver, and six bronze.
 
• Bhavina Patel becoming the first Indian table tennis player to win a Paralympic medal and Harvinder Singh mirroring the feat in archery.
 
• Shooter Avani Lekhara, however, was the standout name as she became the first Indian woman to win a Paralympic gold medal.
 
• China topped the medal tally with 96 gold, 60 silver, and 51 bronze medals. Great Britain and the United States followed to secure second and third positions, respectively.
 
• The closing ceremony was on September 5, 2021, which celebrated the successful completion of the games and included the traditional passing of the Paralympic flag to Paris, the host city of the 2024 Paralympic Games.
